findings.design: V3Step1 renders CERT_GROUPS: certifications are bucketed under uppercase vendor headers (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Linux Foundation / CompTIA), each group preceded by a label row, with the cert row itself showing only the cert name + code badge (vendor is implied by the group). The CanvasSection subtitle explicitly calls this out as a defining feature: 'vendor-grouped cert list'.
findings.app: OnboardingCertSelect.vue renders a single flat <ul> of all certifications with no grouping or vendor section headers; each row instead repeats the provider name inline under the cert name.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Onboarding.html:423-441 (CERT_GROUPS.map / group.vendor header) vs apps/web/app/components/OnboardingCertSelect.vue:57-101 (flat filteredOptions loop, option.provider shown per-item instead of a group header)

findings.design: SearchBox on step 1 shows a right-aligned pill suffix 'N available' reflecting the total certification count.
findings.app: The search input has no trailing count/suffix element of any kind.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Onboarding.html:166-175 (SearchBox suffix prop), :422 (suffix="7 available") vs apps/web/app/components/OnboardingCertSelect.vue:49-55 (bare <input>, no suffix element)

findings.element: Footer divider + spacing above Continue button
findings.design: Step footer nav is visually separated from the list with a top border and 24/20px top margin/padding before the right-aligned Continue button ('display:flex, justifyContent:flex-end, marginTop:24, paddingTop:20, borderTop:1px solid').
findings.app: The Continue button sits as just another flex item in the same `flex flex-col gap-6` stack as the search input and list — no border-top divider or distinct top spacing separates it from the cert list.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Onboarding.html:442-444 vs apps/web/app/components/OnboardingCertSelect.vue:47-48,103-110 (button inside the same gap-6 column, no border-t)

findings.design: SearchBox includes an inline SVG magnifying-glass icon to the left of the placeholder text.
findings.app: Plain `<input type="search">` with no custom leading icon (relies on browser default, if any).

findings.design: Footer Continue button reads 'Continue →' with a trailing arrow glyph.
findings.app: Button label is plain 'Continue' with no arrow.
